ChangeNotes.Value:
v2.2.1 - one fix on top of v2.2.0.
* What Think (Shift+Enter) hands you now always arrives as ONE unbroken line - line breaks in a drafted line confused the writing box
v2.2.0 is the release itself: Think, in the chat and letter windows - your own character works out what to say or write next, from everything the two of you have ever said, and the words land in your writing box to keep, change or throw away. Conversation presets steer it (starter, romantic, ender, or your own). See the previous change note for the whole of it.
Full model guide: github.com/TraxData313/ImmersiveAI/blob/master/docs/choosing-a-model.md
